intent: Independently audit removal of prefilled decision values from candidate11's contract demonstrations before candidate13 preflight.
scope: Prompt integrity and exact intervention fidelity, not demonstrated label-bias causation or model acceptance.

candidate.digest_method: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of all61 messagesFor(case, product, exact policy, v2, true) arrays in frozen order.

exact_diff.description: Two JSON shape demonstrations prefilled with tutoring/scaffolding are replaced by neutral field/type/enum prose and a reference to that definition. All other candidate11 lines remain unchanged. Candidate12's unrelated-domain demonstrations are absent.
exact_diff.new_instruction: There is no default mode or instruction; values must follow current participation and action evidence.

requirement_review.contract: The same reason-first v2 object remains mandatory. Reason/response nonempty types, reason40-word cap, response two-sentence/35-word bound, nested mode/instruction enums, Guard-only null and rejected legacy fields are retained. New prose does not change parser semantics.
requirement_review.G01: Participation entry/persistence/recovery criteria are unchanged. Neutral enum description removes an illustrative default without favoring tutoring or Guard as a rule.
requirement_review.T01_T02: Action eligibility, first-action realization, inventory evidence and consolidation rules are unchanged. Removing prefilled scaffolding does not prescribe another action or change expected labels.
requirement_review.shortcut_integrity: No case IDs, learner utterances, worked behavior answers, response templates or scorer accommodations are added. The intervention removes a repeated label exemplar rather than replacing it with evaluation-specific answer content.

hypothesis_and_limits: Repeated prefilled values are a plausible source of response-label priming, but the existing observations do not establish that causal mechanism.
The intervention jointly removes JSON shape exemplars and adds neutral descriptions/no-default guidance. Any effect may concern formatting or prompt emphasis as well as label priming.
All61cases/183targets, including formatting failures and permitted repairs, must remain in the preflight. Compare directly with candidate11 under the same settings and preserved source.
Full semantic checks, matched-baseline non-regression, independently managed validation and product verification remain separately required. A clear prompt audit is not acceptance.
